about: Inputs and core's outputs for the text helpers the iPhone app keeps a copy of (mobile/src/intent.ts and memory.ts in yeixio/toskar-apps). Core's TestTextVectors checks these against core; the phone's quality run checks them against the phone, so the two cannot drift apart unnoticed. Change a helper in core, then run TOSKAR_UPDATE_TEXT_VECTORS=1 go test ./internal/orchestrator/builtin/simple -run TestTextVectors to rewrite the outputs, and port the change to the phone. classify leaves out messages core sorts as local, a kind the phone does not have.
